title: Rename TempCustomMigrationTableBuffer back to CustomMigrationTableBuffer
summary: A variable name in custom migration mapping is restored from TempCustomMigrationTableBuffer to CustomMigrationTableBuffer to prevent misleading naming and rule violations.
key_points: Variable in the Add Custom Migration Mapping page renamed back to CustomMigrationTableBuffer
The variable is only a handle for calling SaveMigrationTableMapping, not a data buffer
Removes the Temp prefix that violated AA0237 on a non-temporary variable, an error in the NAV build
Restores the pre-#9200 name, consistent with the NAV 28.x backport and PR #9663
Naming-only change with no behavior impact
